---
title: Developer talk moved to Anthropic
version: 1.0.0
styles: [sleek]
---

Every month, Hacker News commenters write thousands of comments that mention OpenAI or Anthropic. Anthropic's share of those mentions passed half in July 2025, peaked in April 2026, fell back to 57% in September and recovered to 65% in October.

```chart
type: combo
title: Anthropic's share of mentions passed half in July 2025
subtitle: Comments that mention Anthropic each month (bars) and its share of OpenAI and Anthropic mentions (line), January 2023 to October 2026
data: {csv: data/hn-comment-mentions-monthly.csv}
encoding: {x: month, y: anthropic_comments, line: anthropic_share}
axes:
  y: {label: Comments}
  y2: {label: Share of mentions, format: percent}
```

*Source: Hacker News items, ClickHouse public copy (sql-clickhouse.clickhouse.com), counted for the flagship report. A comment counts for a company when its text matches openai|chatgpt or anthropic|claude as whole words. Data: data/hn-comment-mentions-monthly.csv.*
